# National Mentoring Resource Center

> Comprehensive federal mentoring resource hub providing evidence-based research, training, and technical assistance for youth mentoring programs nationwide.

The National Mentoring Resource Center (NMRC) is supported by the Office of Juvenile Justice and Delinquency Prevention (OJJDP) and serves as a centralized platform for mentoring practitioners, researchers, and policymakers. The center aggregates evidence reviews, best practices, assessment tools, and training resources to support effective mentoring program implementation across diverse youth populations.

## Key Topics

- youth mentoring

## Core Resources & Getting Started

- [National Mentoring Resource Center](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org): Homepage for NMRC, comprehensive mentoring resource hub with tools, training, and technical assistance.
- [Mentoring Definition & Key Research](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/resources/what-is-mentoring): Foundational guide defining mentoring, frameworks, and key research by DuBois and Karcher.
- [NMRC Resource Library](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/resources): Searchable library of mentoring resources including guides, webinars, and training materials.
- [OJJDP's Investment in Mentoring](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/about/ojjdps-investment-in-mentoring): Overview of OJJDP's federal funding and mentoring initiatives for at-risk youth.

## Research & Evidence Reviews

- [Research Tools Hub](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/research-tools): Hub for NMRC Research Board evidence reviews, tools, and program effectiveness resources.
- [Evidence Reviews](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/research-tools/evidence-reviews): Comprehensive evidence reviews of mentoring models, programs, and practices.
- [Mentoring Model/Population Reviews](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/research-tools/evidence-reviews/mentoring-model-population-reviews): Evidence-based reviews of mentoring models for specific youth populations.
- [Mentoring Program Reviews](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/research-tools/evidence-reviews/mentoring-program-reviews): Systematic reviews and effectiveness ratings of specific mentoring programs.
- [Mentoring Practice Reviews](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/research-tools/evidence-reviews/mentoring-practice-reviews): Evidence reviews of mentoring practices including recruitment, training, and support.
- [Other NMRC and Research Board Publications](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/resources/other-research-board-publications): Guides and publications on youth development, workforce readiness, and law enforcement mentoring.

## Training, Tools & Program Development

- [E-Learning Courses](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/how-we-can-help/e-learning): Online courses and training modules on mentoring best practices and program development.
- [Measurement Guidance Toolkit](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/resource/measurement-guidance-toolkit): Toolkit with assessment tools and metrics for evaluating mentoring program quality.
- [Logic Models & Theories of Change](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/research-tools/logic-models-theories-of-change): Downloadable logic models and theories of change for various mentoring program types.
- [Upcoming Trainings and Events](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/how-we-can-help/upcoming-training): Schedule of no-cost training events and technical assistance offerings from NMRC.

## Programs & Funding Opportunities

- [OJJDP Grantees Map](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/ojjdp-grantee-map): Interactive map and directory of OJJDP-funded mentoring programs across the United States.

## Learning & Community

- [Blog](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/blog): Blog covering mentoring best practices, grantee updates, and youth development topics.
- [Reflections on Research Podcast](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/research-tools/reflections-on-research-podcast): Podcast featuring mentoring research, hope theory, and models for diverse youth populations.

## Engagement & Support

- [Connect with NMRC](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/connect): Contact and feedback submission form for NMRC users and stakeholders.
- [Nominate Programs or Resources](https://nationalmentoringresourcecenter.org/research-tools/nominate-programs-or-resources): Form to nominate mentoring programs and resources for NMRC database inclusion.
